businessSettings.serviceChargeHint: Used only when no charge band below matches.

businessSettings.splitTaxOff: The bill will show a single combined {{label}} line. Only correct for inter-state supply.
businessSettings.fssaiHint: Printed on every bill. Required for a licensed food business.
businessSettings.receiptHeaderHint: Address, phone. One per line, printed under your name.
businessSettings.receiptFooterHint: Printed at the bottom of every bill. One per line.
